name: university-identity-platform
description: Central Identity and User Management Platform - microservices root helper

scripts.install:all: cd api-gateway && npm install && cd ../registration-service && npm install && cd ../login-service && npm install && cd ../admin-service && npm install && cd ../user-service && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n GATEWAY,REGISTER,LOGIN,ADMIN,USER -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm --prefix api-gateway start" "npm --prefix registration-service start" "npm --prefix login-service start" "npm --prefix admin-service start" "npm --prefix user-service start"
